title: How does a caterpillar become a butterfly?
examples: What is the chrysalis made of?
How long does the change take?
Does the butterfly eat when it is a chrysalis?

explain.say: A caterpillar spends its days eating lots of green leaves.

draw.text: How does a caterpillar become a butterfly?

explain.say: Now look. This is the life cycle of a butterfly in 3D. Can you see the eggs and the caterpillar? Tap any part to hear about it.

draw.text: How does a caterpillar become a butterfly?

explain.say: When it is big enough, the caterpillar makes a hard case around itself.
This resting stage is called the chrysalis.
Inside the chrysalis, there is a big change. It is called metamorphosis.
After the change, a butterfly pushes its way out.
When you see a butterfly, remember it was once a caterpillar.

faq.a: The chrysalis is a hard case. It forms from the caterpillar's own skin and keeps it safe while it changes.
Metamorphosis is the big process of changing from one life form to another. It is how the caterpillar becomes a butterfly.
asks: What does it mean to change form?

faq.q: How long does the change take?
faq.a: The time it takes can be different depending on the kind of butterfly. Some changes happen quite quickly.

faq.q: Does the caterpillar eat when it is a chrysalis?
faq.a: No, the caterpillar does not eat when it is in the chrysalis. It is resting and changing inside.

faq.q: What is the difference between a chrysalis and a cocoon?
faq.a: A chrysalis is the hard shell for butterflies. A cocoon is usually made by moths and is different.

facts: Caterpillars eat leaves to grow bigger.
The protective shell is called a chrysalis.
The entire change process is called metamorphosis.
Butterflies emerge from the chrysalis to fly.

quiz.say: Where does a caterpillar rest and change?
quiz.why: The caterpillar changes inside a hard case called a chrysalis.

wrong.0: The egg comes first, before the caterpillar.

quiz.say: What is the big change from caterpillar to butterfly called?
quiz.why: Metamorphosis means a big change in body shape.

wrong.1: Hibernation is a long winter sleep.
wrong.2: Migration is a long journey with the seasons.

quiz.why: The caterpillar makes a chrysalis, and the butterfly comes out of it.

wrong.0: The chrysalis comes before the butterfly.
wrong.1: The caterpillar comes first, before the butterfly.
